nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: Ah, a curious wanderer approaches the Sapphire Prism. Can you hear the whispers vibrating across the floor?

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: Tell me, traveler. What seekest thou in this boundless expanse of white?

options.text: I seek knowledge about this corridor.

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: Knowledge is a heavy burden. The corridor connects echoes of rooms long forgotten...

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: An exit? All doors lead forward, yet all lead back to where you started.

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: Exploration without purpose often uncovers the most hidden truths.

nodes.speaker: THE VOICE
nodes.text: Remember this: not all who wander these chambers are truly alone.
